title: Sanitize terminal control sequences in chat content
description: Prevent untrusted messages from injecting ANSI, OSC, C0, or C1 controls into peer terminals while preserving supported Unicode text and safe whitespace. Apply consistently in styled and plaintext modes.

comments.author: bscott

title: Stop leaking client cancellation goroutines
description: Tie plaintext and TUI cancellation watchers to each client lifecycle so normal disconnects do not retain one goroutine and client object until server shutdown.

comments.author: bscott

title: Make room and server shutdown safe
description: Prevent sends to closed room channels, order connection shutdown before room teardown, and make repeated shutdown safe. Cover active-client shutdown under the race detector.

comments.author: bscott

title: Make room admission synchronous and race-free
description: Replace fullRoomRejection polling with a synchronous join result. Enforce max users before callers continue, remove the data race, and prevent rejected plaintext clients from broadcasting.

comments.author: bscott

title: Prevent TUI crash when chat room is full
description: Reject over-capacity TUI connections without using the plaintext writer or panicking. Return a typed admission result to the TUI and cover the capacity boundary with regression tests.

comments.author: bscott

title: Release TUI nickname reservation when join command is dropped
description: If Bubble Tea exits after ReserveNickname succeeds but before the queued join command executes, handleTUI Leave sees only a nil reservation and cannot release it. Tie reservations to client lifecycle or explicitly release the pending nickname on TUI exit without evicting another client. Add a deterministic regression test. Follow-up from Claude review of fix/repository-review-findings.

title: Add first-party Chat Tails TUI client mode
description: After the repository-review fixes are reviewed and merged, design and implement a first-party client invoked as chat-tails --client --host <HOST> with explicit port and connection options, Bubble Tea UI reuse, clean disconnect behavior, and compatibility with the existing server protocol. Do not start this work on the current bug-fix branch.
close_reason: Added and verified first-party TUI client, Docker Compose deployment, release binaries, and curl installer.

title: Correct Tailscale and Docker hostname behavior
description: Use a dedicated TS_HOSTNAME container variable, avoid Docker's container-ID HOSTNAME default, and advertise the actual MagicDNS name rather than an invalid hostname.ts.net address.

comments.author: bscott

title: Bound TUI message retention and rendering work
description: Cap per-client TUI message retention and avoid rebuilding unbounded session history on every incoming message. Preserve scrolling and configured recent history behavior.

comments.author: bscott

title: Validate server configuration before startup
description: Validate port, max users, history size, room name, and Tailscale hostname in server construction. Return actionable errors instead of slice panics or invalid listeners.

comments.author: bscott

title: Make telnet negotiation parsing lossless
description: Remove the blind input drain and implement stateful IAC filtering across TCP read boundaries so fast netcat input and fragmented telnet negotiations are preserved correctly.

comments.author: bscott
